rationale: Despite severe broad market weakness (SPY -2.82%, VIXY +17.14%), ADMA continues to show exceptional relative strength, holding in the top 12% of its daily range at $13.10 and well above the rising session VWAP ($12.82) on 7.53x relative volume. Although a recent 1-minute pullback brought price slightly below the 5-minute 9-EMA ($13.12), the $13.00 breakout level is acting as support, leaving the bullish structure intact and invalidation at $12.79 well protected.
